title: AT&T and Ericsson Enhance Wireless Capacity, Coverage, and Performance Nationwide
summary: AT&T has selected Ericsson to provide 600 MHz dual-band radios to support deployment of newly acquired spectrum from EchoStar.
body_markdown: AT&T has selected Ericsson to provide 600 MHz dual-band radios to support deployment of newly acquired spectrum from EchoStar.
